en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a landscaped park with a large reflective pond or lake in the foreground. A fountain rises from the center of the water, with a small building or pavilion at the far shore. Dense trees surround the water, and on the distant hilltop the ruins and towers of a castle can be seen. There is a small bridge on the right bank. Printed text at the top reads "WENDEN Schloss-Park".
